headline: Data Center Dynamics reports that IREN, an AI cloud company, is targeting a 900-megawatt data center campus near Wagga Wagga, Australia.
score_reason: Stays at the pool score: a large proposed campus, but at an early, unapproved stage.
importance_line: Communities near Wagga Wagga and IREN's investors are affected, but the campus is a proposal with power not yet secured and local approvals only beginning.
source: Data Center Dynamics, as summarised by Simply Wall St
summary: Data Center Dynamics reports, as summarised by Simply Wall St, that IREN, which runs an AI cloud platform in Australia and Canada, has proposed a 900-megawatt data center campus near Wagga Wagga in Australia, where power is not yet secured and community approvals are only starting.
notes: Data Center Dynamics page blocked (HTTP 403); details come from a short Simply Wall St note, which is analyst commentary. Headline plus that note only.
